verifications.claim: An appendectomy is the surgical removal of the appendix.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Appendectomy (Appendix Removal)"; "Appendectomy is an operation to remove the appendix"; "surgery to remove your appendix"; "An appendectomy is surgery to take out your appendix."
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly define appendectomy as surgical removal of the appendix.

verifications.claim: Appendectomy is typically performed to treat acute appendicitis.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Most appendectomies occur within 24 hours of your appendicitis diagnosis"; "performed for appendicitis"; "standard treatment for suspected appendicitis"; "when appendicitis, the inflammation of the appendix"; "when your appendix becomes infected, a condition called appendicitis."
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources state appendectomy treats appendicitis.

verifications.claim: Appendectomy is most commonly done via laparoscopy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Laparoscopic appendectomy"; "A laparoscopic (lap-a-ro-SKOPP-ik) or “lap” appendectomy is a minimally invasive surgery"; "In most laparoscopic appendectomies"; "Laparoscopic appendectomy generally offers a quicker recovery and less postoperative pain, making it the preferred option"; "the most common for simple appendicitis."
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe laparoscopic as preferred, common, or standard for most cases.

verifications.claim: Laparoscopy for appendectomy uses 1–4 small incisions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Make one to three small incisions"; "make 1 to 3 small incisions"; "surgeons operate through 3 small incisions"; "using only 2-3 small incisions"; "1 to 3 tiny cuts"; "Most operations need 3 incisions, but this can vary from 1 (one) to 4."
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify 1-3 or up to 4 small incisions for laparoscopic appendectomy.

verifications.claim: Laparoscopy for appendectomy uses a camera.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "laparoscope — a long, thin tube with a tiny light and a high-resolution camera"; "thin tube with a camera"; "a laparoscope (a tiny telescope connected to a video camera)"; "insert a small camera"; "A long, thin tube called a laparoscope... It has a tiny video camera."
verifications.reasoning: All laparoscopic descriptions mention a camera or laparoscope with camera.

verifications.claim: Laparoscopy for appendectomy uses gas to inflate the abdomen for better visibility.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "inflate your belly with carbon dioxide gas. (This makes more room for the operation and allows for clearer views)"; "a tube to start a flow of carbon dioxide, a harmless gas, into the abdominal space; the gas will puff up the abdomen"; "Carbon dioxide gas will be used to swell up your abdomen"; "fill the abdomen with gas. This creates space to do the operation."
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources for visibility and space.

verifications.claim: Open surgery is used for more complex cases of appendectomy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "switch gears” from laparoscopic... if you have widespread infection"; "more difficult to perform if there is advanced infection or the appendix has ruptured. A traditional, open procedure"; "If your appendix has burst and infection has spread, you may need an open appendectomy"; "if my appendix bursts... clean the inside of your abdomen."
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify open for ruptured, infected, or complex cases.

verifications.claim: Laparoscopic appendectomy is the preferred method.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "minimally invasive surgery"; "Laparoscopic appendectomy has many benefits"; "making it the preferred option for many patients"; "A less invasive method is a laparoscopic appendectomy"; "This technique is the most common for simple appendicitis."
verifications.reasoning: Described as preferred, minimally invasive, or most common.

verifications.claim: Appendectomy is performed under general anesthesia.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "general anesthesia so you can sleep through your surgery"; "under general anesthesia"; "under general anaesthetic"; "under general anesthesia"; "You will have general anesthesia for your laparoscopic appendectomy."

verifications.claim: Appendectomy typically takes 30 to 60 minutes for uncomplicated cases.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "about one hour to complete"; "The surgery will take about 1 hour"; "typically last an hour"; "about 30 minutes to one hour for non-complicated cases."
verifications.reasoning: Sources match 30-60 minutes or about one hour for uncomplicated.

verifications.claim: Most patients return to normal activities in 1–3 weeks after appendectomy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "go back to work in 1 to 3 weeks"; "get back to most of your normal activities in one to two weeks"; "go back to work or school in one to three weeks"; "Laparoscopic surgery is between three and seven days."
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches for 1-3 weeks return to work/normal activities.

verifications.claim: Full recovery from appendectomy takes about 4–6 weeks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Full recovery, including the healing of internal tissues, can take 4-6 weeks."
verifications.reasoning: Direct match in R7; others imply similar timelines.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Risks involved in the lap appendectomy include: Infection"; "Infection"; "infection in the wound, tummy or chest"; "Infection at the incision site"; "Wound infection"; "infection at the incision site."

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Bleeding"; "Bleeding"; "bleeding and bruising"; "Bleeding or blood clots"; "Bleeding"; "Bruising, bleeding, or infection."

verifications.claim: Risks of appendectomy include injury to other organs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Injury to adjacent organs such as the small intestine, ureter, or bladder"; "injury to other organs or structures"; "Rare injury to surrounding organs"; "risk of hurting other body parts... bladder, large intestine (colon), or small intestine."

verifications.claim: If the appendix bursts before surgery, the abdomen will be cleaned out to treat infection.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Drain any infection... Rinse your abdominal cavity with a sterile saline solution"; "the surgeon will clean out his or her abdomen to help treat any infection"; "your abdomen will be washed out with salt water (saline)"; "Your surgeon will clean the inside of your abdomen."

verifications.claim: Patients often go home within 1–2 days after appendectomy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "go home the same day... or a few more days"; "1 to 2 days"; "1-2 days"; "stay in the hospital for one to two days"; "typical hospital stay is often just 1-2 days"; "1 day after a laparoscopic."
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm 1-2 days or same day for uncomplicated.

verifications.claim: An IV line will be started in preparation for appendectomy
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "place an IV line into a vein so they can give you antibiotics"; "an IV will be started so that medication can be given."
